Ranked by recurrence and cheaply estimable precision gain, NOT by whether the ranking would let any unit be marked Safe.

c02_selection.one_line: Use the Clang typed AST the gateway already imports to admit a bounded, whitelisted class of direct field accesses as resource-projection NoOps, leaving everything else Unknown.

admit_only_if_all_hold: The statement contains no call expression anywhere.

Every member or subscript access in the statement is a direct field access whose base is a DeclRefExpr naming a formal or local (no chained deref, no computed base, no array subscript on a non-constant index).
Each accessed field's DECLARED type, taken from the typed AST, is a non-pointer arithmetic or enumeration type.
No accessed field is a member of a union, and no enclosing record on the access path is a union.
No accessed field is qualified volatile or _Atomic.
The statement takes no address of any sub-object (no address-of escape).
The assigned value, where the statement is an assignment, is itself free of calls and of unmodeled access.
admission_rule.otherwise: Unknown, exactly as today. The rule is a whitelist over a typed premise; it never relaxes an existing rejection without that premise.

c02_selection.soundness_argument: A write to a field of non-pointer arithmetic or enum type outside any union cannot create, destroy, alias or transfer a tracked resource identity, so it is custody-neutral for the resource projection. Union members are excluded because a scalar write can overwrite an overlapping pointer member. Volatile and _Atomic are excluded because they carry side effects the projection does not model. Classifying the statement as a NoOp asserts no validity of the base object: if the access traps, that path simply does not reach an exit, which can only remove leak witnesses, never add one.
why_this_family: It is rank 1 on every recurrence axis measured: most diagnostics (18,671), most functions (3,233 of 4,688), most units (171 of 185), most often the earliest diagnostic in a function (1,590), and the largest sole-blocker family among the families that actually block these six functions (298).
It blocks all six Unknown functions, which no other family does.

It is the ROOT of this unit's causal chain: it is why cmt_counter_destroy's body is not fully modeled, which is why W4 publishes no summary for it, which is why cmt_counter_create's two calls to it are uncontracted, which is why the calloc obligation at preprocessed line 5466 stays live at both early returns and the raw unit is provisional Unsafe.

It is admissible fail-closed: the typed premise already exists in the gateway (typed_c_ast / boolean_source consume the same Clang AST for the same unit), and the rule is a conjunctive whitelist that cannot flip an Unknown without that premise.
It is generic: the rule is expressed entirely over declared C types and expression shapes. No library, record or symbol name appears in it.

The alternatives are worse. Rank 2 (uncontracted_call) is not admissible as an analysis feature at all. Rank 3 (branch_condition) has only 42 sole-blocker functions and is best delivered as an extension of this same typed classification. Rank 4 (unknown_alias) has zero sole-blocker functions and is a consequence, not a cause. Ranks 5-7 are single-unit or narrow.
explicitly_not_claimed: This capability does NOT make any of the six functions a checked function contract. Each of the six additionally needs either a source-contract ABI/vocabulary extension (five of them) or cross-translation-unit callee contracts (four of them), or both.

This capability does NOT promote the raw CMetrics unit. cmt_counter_create retains uncontracted cmt_log_print, cmt_map_create and cmt_counter_destroy calls and both leak diagnostics; the unit stays provisional Unsafe.

Within this unit the capability changes exactly one function's resource projection: cmt_counter_allow_reset's single statement `counter->allow_reset = 1` becomes modeled, leaving that function with no diagnostics. Probes R12 and R13 show an otherwise-empty borrowed-pointer function classifies Safe, so its RESOURCE status would move Unknown to Safe. That is a separate verdict from its already-checked source contract, and neither promotes the unit.

Removing state poisoning can SURFACE leak and unknown_alias diagnostics that are currently masked, so the corpus effect may include new provisional Unsafe results. That is a precision gain, not a regression, and a provisional Unsafe is never an upstream defect claim.

Because all four archived 185-unit artifacts would change, hard invariant 3 (parity before deletion) and hard invariant 5 (pinned expectations are intentional) require the new artifacts to be regenerated, diffed and re-pinned deliberately, with the diff archived under docs/reports/.
c02_selection.bounded_requirement_if_c02_is_declined: If the typed-AST bridge into the token-level interpreter is judged too large for one card, the fallback bounded requirement is rank 6 alone: non-custodial scalar out-slot classification (legacy_c.rs:3006). Admit a store through a formal whose declared type is pointer-to-arithmetic as custody-neutral instead of poisoning all pointer state. It needs the same typed premise on a single formal rather than on arbitrary field paths, covers 676 diagnostics across 262 functions and 87 units, and unblocks exactly one of cmt_counter_get_val's three blockers. It promotes nothing.
